B1.description: multi-asset spot-perp basis aggregate Martingale (6 base assets)

M2R.description: constrained factor-residual basket (iterative projection solve: beta-neutral + box[0.25] + normalize)
M2R.note: F2 has no 8-symbol combo satisfying all constraints (structural beta dispersion); other folds feasible

P1.description: partial-cointegration state-space (RW trend + MR detrended component; only MR signals; RW share + MR half-life gate)
P1.method: detrend residual to extract MR component; gate rw_var_share<=0.40 + mr_half_life<=168h + mr_coeff converges

K1.description: spurious-control Kalman time-varying beta + 4 adversarial controls (random-walk null, permuted symbols, fixed cointegration, synthetic time-varying)
K1.method: Kalman filter with process/observation noise; ctrl1 verifies filter distinguishes RW (high var) from real pair (low var)

V1.description: sparse VECM aggregate Martingale (Johansen rank-1 power iteration + adaptive sparsification; 8-symbol basket)
V1.note: feasibility (long/short gross both >=0.35) varies; G1 gate will block infeasible folds
